summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # **-** ** Petition No. 01/SM/2020 (Suo Motu) ** # **Coram:** # **Shri P.K. Pujari, Chairperson Shri I.S. Jha, Member** ## **Date of Order: 23** **rd** **March, 2020** ## **In the matter of:** Extension of Pilot on Security Constrained Economic Dispatch (SCED) ## ** ORDER ** The Commission vide its suo motu Order dated 31 st January, 2019 in Petition No. 02/SM/2019, directed Power System Operation Corporation (POSOCO) to implement a Pilot on Security Constrained Economic Despatch (SCED) w.e.f 01.04.2019, for Inter-State Generating Stations. The prime driver behind the pilot was to explore the scope of optimisation and, therefore, the possibility of minimising the system cost without major structural changes in the existing system. 2. Subsequently, the Commission extended the duration of pilot up to 31 st March, 2020 vide its order in Petition No. 08/SM/2019 (Suo-Motu) dated 11 th September, 2019 and made certain modifications in the earlier order dated Order in Petition No. 01/SM/2020 (Suo-Motu) Page 1 of 2 31.01.2019 in Petition No. 02/SM/2019. In the order, the Commission also gave directions regarding sharing of benefits accrued from SCED among generators and beneficiaries/ DISCOMs. 3. POSOCO has submitted detailed feedback report on implementation of SCED pilot and suggested way forward. The report is being examined by the Commission. In the interim, the Commission, hereby, decides to extend implementation of the SCED pilot till 31 st May, 2020, on the same principles as in the Commission's order in Petition No. 08/SM/2019 (Suo-Motu) dated 11 th September, 2019. ## 4. POSOCO is directed to act accordingly. **Sd/[I. S. Jha] MEMBER** **Sd/[P.K Pujari] CHAIRPERSON** Order in Petition No. 01/SM/2020 (Suo-Motu) Page 2 of 2
title: Extension of Pilot on Security Constrained Economic Despatch (SCED)
